name: Keep going after a failure
description: Reads a worksheet that may be missing and, if that fails, logs the reason instead of stopping the run.

notes.text: WHAT IT DOES: Flow.Try catches a failure of the node before it, so nothing after it turns red; Flow.When lets the logging run only when it did fail, and Log.Write adds the error text to the log file. TO CHANGE: put any risky node where the worksheet reader is, and set the log path.
